title: The leak scan flags a table row whose label cell is followed by a header-like cell and a long identifier, with no key material
goal: kbcommon.leak_hits does not flag a same-line table row that holds an armor label, a Name: value cell and a 20-or-more-character identifier cell but no key material, as c927cb22e did not, while every key block the SP-evq2flqc reviews planted is still flagged

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbcommon;d='-'*5;t='| '+d+'BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY'+d+' | Note: PEM label | PrivateKeyInfoStructureXX |';h=any(k=='secret' for k,_ in kbcommon.leak_hits(t));print('label row flagged:',h);sys.exit(1 if h else 0)

notes: Found 2026-10-23 by the third SP-evq2flqc fresh review on 86d646801: the boundary header value now crosses a pipe, so a 24-character identifier cell counts as the base64 run.
